title: Strata vocabulary pack (.vocab.json)
description: A shareable list of span, point-marker and mode types. Importing copies the terms into a .strata file's vocabulary, each tagged with source '{name} v{version}', so the analysis opens without the pack. See schema/strata-schema-reference.md, 'Vocabulary packs'.

strataVocabPack.description: Marks the file as a Strata vocabulary pack, and gives the pack format's version. Written on export; optional on import.

version.description: The pack's own version, e.g. '1.0.0'. Defaults to 1.0.0 on import.
